name: Report card
oneLiner: a cream card-stock report card is laid on an open manila folder on a leather desk, its rules and crest printed in the brand colour; grades are written in blue pen ink row by row, the pen lying beside it, the final grade lands big, then a green double ring is stamped round it and the card gives under the stamp as the camera drifts
say: when the speaker grades or scores something ('I gave each tool a grade', 'here is how it scored', 'it gets an A from me'): the grades write in as they go through them and the ring lands on the final verdict
